notes:
- Account overview: Aurora CodeOps builds an internal CI/PR quality platform (sre + developer ergonomics). Looking to replace rule-based heuristics with ML-powered PR reviewer.
- Use-case specifics: diff summarization + automated comment generation (3 ranked suggestions) for reviewers; reranking to surface the best suggested comment; in-IDE streaming for live suggestion while author edits. Model pinning per repo required (cannot degrade older codebases).
- Security: Must support SSO (SAML) mapped groups, enterprise audit logs, KMS integration for keys, and data residency controls (EU for some customers). POC will run in Redwood Dedicated or Redwood Private inside VPC.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market procurement — wants to understand token economics for heavy-day bursts (up to 300 PRs/day with large diffs). Interested in Optimize recommendations (quantization + batching) to reduce cost without quality regression.
- Technical ask from CTO (quote paraphrase): "If you can hit low-latency streaming and we can pin stable models per repo, we can decommission our current heuristic reviewer."
- Integration notes: wants GitHub App + webhooks for PR events, JetBrains/VSCode plugin to surface streamed suggestions, and an API for A/B testing different reranker models. Also asked for a test harness to run historical PRs (5000 PRs) for offline accuracy metrics.
- Evaluation criteria: summary F1 against human labels, top-3 suggestion acceptance rate in pilot, latency percentiles (p50/p95), and cost per accepted suggestion.
- Quote from engineering lead: "Need reliable fallbacks — if dedicated capacity dips, automatically route to a cheaper model variant with similar behavior."
- Next milestone: security questionnaire response due 2025-02-20; schedule VPC peering with infra (target window: 2025-02-27 to 2025-03-03).
